title: Beyond Similarity through Zero-Token Geometric Graphs for Multi-Hop RAG
abstract: arXiv:2609.19622v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires evidence that remains relevant to a query while introducing enough novelty to bridge semantic gaps. Dense retrieval tends to concentrate on semantically similar documents, whereas graph-based alternatives often depend on costly Large Language Model (LLM) entity extraction and may propagate through noisy connections. We introduce Geometric Gain Graph RAG (G$^3$RAG), a document-only framework whose offline graph construction uses no LLM calls or generated tokens. G$^3$RAG assigns each edge a geometric gain score, $\cos\theta \cdot \sin\theta$, that jointly captures directional consistency and orthogonality between document representations. A density-aware topological penalty suppresses highly connected hubs, while single-step controlled diffusion expands from filtered query seeds toward complementary evidence. We evaluate G$^3$RAG on MusiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and HotpotQA using Nv-emb

translated_title: 通过零令牌几何图超越相似性的多跳RAG
translated_abstract: 多跳检索增强生成（RAG）所需的证据既要与查询保持相关性，又要引入足够的新颖性以弥合语义鸿沟。密集检索往往集中于语义相似的文档，而基于图的替代方案通常依赖于代价高昂的大语言模型（LLM）实体抽取，并可能通过噪声连接进行传播。我们提出了几何增益图RAG（G$^3$RAG），这是一个仅基于文档的框架，其离线图构建过程不使用任何LLM调用或生成的令牌。G$^3$RAG为每条边分配一个几何增益分数 $\cos\theta \cdot \sin\theta$，该分数联合刻画了文档表示之间的方向一致性与正交性。密度感知的拓扑惩罚抑制了高度连接的枢纽节点，同时单步受控扩散从过滤后的查询种子向互补证据进行扩展。我们在MusiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA和HotpotQA数据集上使用Nv-emb（摘要截断）对G$^3$RAG进行了评估。
tldr: 提出G³RAG框架，通过无需LLM调用和生成令牌的离线图构建，结合cosθ·sinθ几何增益分数、密度感知拓扑惩罚和单步受控扩散，在多跳RAG中实现超越纯相似性检索的互补证据发现。
en_tdlr: G³RAG is a document-only multi-hop RAG framework that builds offline graphs with zero LLM calls, using a geometric gain score (cosθ·sinθ), density-aware topological penalties, and single-step controlled diffusion to retrieve complementary evidence beyond mere similarity.
